prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: preview-only visual direction sketch for a desktop web operations dashboard
Primary request: Create one deliberately unfinished, flat matte UI direction sketch for DUMA, a contemporary café operations system. This is a directional concept board, not a polished production screenshot and not a photoreal scene.
Canvas: landscape desktop frame, exactly 1536 × 1024 pixels, straight-on view, full interface visible with generous outer margin.
Structure: a narrow left navigation rail and one broad operational workspace. Organize the workspace as horizontal depth bands: a bright cyan shop-floor layer across the top, then crisp stepped bands that become progressively deeper blue for management layers below. This progression must be made from distinct flat color fields with hard boundaries, never a gradient. Use asymmetric, task-led composition rather than a grid of equal cards. Include a queue-like top band, a wide schedule/operations field, a dense tabular management band, and a small exception area.
UI treatment: clear flat cards with small 6–8px corner radii, thin rules, matte fills, no elevated shadow. Compact operational controls, row dividers, queues, status markers, small bar/line patterns, and familiar dashboard affordances. Show states with redundant signals: distinct icons or simple geometric marks plus solid/dashed/hatched patterns and placement, so color is never the only signal. One and only one coral exception marker.
Composition: DUMA in the upper-left navigation rail. “Run the shift clearly” is the single workspace headline. Everything else must be non-language greeked interface copy: indistinct horizontal bars and abstract placeholder lines, with no readable words, letters, numbers, prices, dates, or fake labels.
Style/medium: crisp 2D digital product design sketch, flat matte vector-like rendering, intentionally one refinement pass short of polished, pragmatic café-operations energy, strong hierarchy and scanability.
Color palette: use only #F4FBFA, #2D9C9C, #3F68B2, #182C4D, and #F09A65, plus opacity variants of those same colors. The cyan #2D9C9C dominates the shop-floor top band; #3F68B2 bridges operational and management depth; #182C4D anchors the deepest band and left rail; #F4FBFA is the calm base; #F09A65 appears once as the only exception.
Text (verbatim): “DUMA” and “Run the shift clearly”
Constraints: render those two phrases accurately and legibly, and no other legible text anywhere. Make the state system visually understandable without relying only on hue. Keep corners 6–8px, never pillowy.
Avoid: gradients of any kind; glassmorphism; blur; gloss; generic bento-dashboard card grids; oversized KPI cards; floating hero metrics; photorealism; people; coffee cups or café photography; water or ocean imagery; waves; sparkle icons; starburst icons; AI-looking decoration; 3D; excessive shadows; rounded pill cards; extra readable text; lorem ipsum.
